source: KODAK VERITA 200D Color Negative Film 5206 / 7206, Technical Information, publication H-1-5206, p.3
tag: SHEET (curve digitised from the PDF vector paths; reading is mine)
notes: Read per the sheet's own rule: density on the record's characteristic curve -> same log exposure on that record's granularity curve -> sigma_D x 1000. Target density = that record's D-min (left end of plotted curve) + 1.0. Axis fit from the sheet's own tick marks (log sigma axis residual <= 0.25 pt). Uncertainty: about +/-4% from line width (+/-1 pt), +/-3% from a +/-0.05 D target shift; Kodak's own note says the granularity and sensitometric curves come from different equipment ('a slight variation in curve shape may be noticed'), so treat as +/-10%. What it is: an Eastman Kodak MOTION-PICTURE camera negative (5206 35/65 mm, 7206 16 mm), EI 200, 5500 K daylight, ECN-2, announced April 2026, developed with Sam Levinson / Marcell Rev for Euphoria season 3; not a still film. On THIS sheet the upper of the two lower dashed curves is labelled 'Red Grain' and the lower 'Green Grain' (red grainier than green), the reverse of the Vision3 sheets; assigned by the printed labels.
